title: Harry Styles receives Guinness World Record for longest Wembley Stadium run
facts: Harry Styles received a Guinness World Record for completing 12 sold-out concerts at Wembley Stadium. [cite: 251]
Harry Styles broke the official record for the longest residency by a musician at Wembley Stadium in a single run. [cite: 251]
The band Coldplay held the previous Wembley Stadium residency record with 10 nights in 2025. [cite: 251]
Will Munford served as the official Guinness World Records adjudicator for Harry Styles' record. [cite: 251]
Harry Styles started the London leg of his Together, Together tour on June 12, 2026. [cite: 251]
Approximately 80,000 people attended the final show of Harry Styles' Wembley Stadium run. [cite: 251]
The boyband One Direction formed in 2010 on the television talent show The X Factor. [cite: 251]
The music group One Direction went on an indefinite hiatus in 2016. [cite: 251]
Former One Direction bandmate Liam Payne died at the age of 31 in 2024. [cite: 251]
Harry Styles officially launched his solo music career in 2017. [cite: 251]
Harry Styles released his fourth studio album, titled 'Kiss All The Time. Disco, Occasionally', in January 2026. [cite: 251]
Harry Styles has received six Brit Awards and three Grammy Awards throughout his solo career. [cite: 251]
Wembley Stadium unveiled a commemorative banner to mark Harry Styles' 12-show record. [cite: 251]
Harry Styles performed exclusively in London for the United Kingdom leg of his current tour. [cite: 251]
Taylor Swift previously played an eight-night residency at Wembley Stadium in 2024. [cite: 251]
